trigger: The original preregistration authorized coordinate auditing but did not enumerate the reference-derived ATP-pocket residues or a coordinate-level hidden-covalency rule. These rules are frozen after reading 2RGP only and before downloading or parsing any other candidate coordinate file.

reference.pocket_derivation: wild-type chain-A standard amino-acid residues with at least one heavy atom within 6.0 A of any HYZ heavy atom
reference.anchor_derivation: the subset of reference-pocket residues with at least one heavy atom within 4.0 A of any HYZ heavy atom

coordinate_gate.chain_identifier: author chain from the frozen metadata candidate CSV
coordinate_gate.alternate_location_rule: highest occupancy, then blank, A, and lexical tie-break
coordinate_gate.alignment: proper-rotation Kabsch alignment using same-number, same-residue-name protein C-alpha atoms
coordinate_gate.global_incomplete_residue_policy: record only during structural selection; freeze and apply one deterministic heavy-atom completion protocol before receptor preparation and redocking

features: pairwise ATP-pocket side-chain heavy-atom centroid distances
structural_selection.standardization: feature-wise z score over all coordinate-eligible structures, followed by division by square root of retained feature count
structural_selection.selection_rule: deterministic max-min structural distance seeded by EGFR_2RGP_reference; ties resolved by lexical conformer ID
structural_selection.failure_action: stop without ligand preparation, docking, QUBO fitting, validation sampling, or validation access if fewer than 16 structures pass

authorization: Download and audit all 31 frozen metadata candidates, then perform label-independent structural max-min selection only.
interpretation_boundary: Passing this gate only establishes a structurally diverse, noncovalent, ATP-site candidate pool. Preparation and co-crystal redocking remain mandatory before any EGFR benchmark docking; no enrichment, QUBO, quantum-application, or quantum-advantage claim follows from this gate.
